newsitem.title: USA: First Virginia sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: First Virginia sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: First Virginia Banks Inc said Wednesday its board has declared a three-for-two stock split of the company's common stock.

The split will be accounted for as a partial stock split under New York Stock Exchange rules and will be paid on September 3, 1997, to shareholders of record at the close of business on August 13, 1997, it said.
The company said the stock split will increase the number of First Virginia shares outstanding to approximately 52,977,000, from 35,318,000 shares outstanding currently.
